ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65 high-intensity (white/light grey) to 0.35 low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density dark-grey mottling and stippling distributed across both lobes. Dense, low-intensity linear streaks are concentrated on the right lobe (medial to distal region). Darker pixel clusters are visible along the perimeter of the median notch and the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.15 relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) ranging from 5 to 30 pixels in depth along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged indentations are present on the inner-mid sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave mathematical curve from the notch to the tips, which exhibit an upward vertical sweep relative to the median horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel groups (3-10 pixel diameter) located along the outer distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe, oriented diagonally; several vertical linear disruptions are visible on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant jaggedness and material voids along the trailing edge topography indicate historical mechanical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-frequency 'salt-and-pepper' stippling effect across the entire ventral pixel surface.
